summary: Gemensamt mobilkoordinatplan. Ett original per pose, samma höjdskalning i mobil och desktop. JSON skiljer källvärden från nya rekommendationer och oprövade kalibreringar.

authority.newRecommendations: Package-specific authoring/delivery defaults, not claimed existing runtime requirements
authority.uncalibratedValues: Draft table silhouette, editable hand regions, camera intrinsics, shoe point and physical depth must not be presented as measured truth
authority.changingContract: Create a new contract version and revalidate dependent poses/clips; AI review cannot mutate this document.

sources.mapping: canonical x = legacy x - 420; canonical y = legacy y + 108

sources.scope: Read-only snapshot. No GitHub writes or deploys.

sources.note: Mask is model guidance, not pixel lock. Local composite is the actual pixel-preservation step.

coordinateSystem.handedness: Viewer-left and dealer-left differ. Never mirror media implicitly. Box 1 is viewer-left.

shoe.source: Inverse of uploaded user calibration, not a measured universal dealer pickup location

openai_pose_work.note: Exact 9:16. Uniform scale 16/15 from canonical, inverse 15/16. No crop or padding.

rendering.sameSizeMeaning: Same viewport height -> same actor pixel height, irrespective of viewport width. Not the same physical size on different displays.

wideMaster.note: Even integer-pixel source for exact centre copy, not a native provider/video requirement.

desktop1080FromWide.note: Height-based resampling with fractional centre crop; exact geometry, not byte-identical RGB after resampling.

doNotCopyLegacyPerViewportZoom.source: Paow coordinate preview in repo; not global live room settings

layers.content: Room only. No foreground blackjack table, dealer, cards, chips or UI.

layers.note: Optional split needed if table must cover lower body; not a second independently decoded video.

layers.content: Table only, transparent outside, no dealer or baked room.
Engine-driven separate card assets at registered targets. Never duplicate a generated physical card without a handoff mask.

layers.note: Arbitrary automatic y-split is not anatomically correct across every action.

layers.content: Optional table rail/props requiring separate occlusion.
Screen-space interface, independent of world coordinate geometry.

dealer_keystone.web: PNG or lossless WebP; no JPEG for locked pose comparisons

table.sourceEditing: Layered PSD/Krita/Blender allowed as authoring sources; export registered PNG to this tool. These sources are not runtime formats.
avoid: resize based only on visible object bounds
table.cropPolicy: Full-scene transparent canvas by default; trimmed assets require explicit placement and registration (not imported automatically by Light).
table.animation: Prefer static table. Animated table needs separately tested alpha-video delivery, not ordinary H.264 MP4.

background_still.note: Quality values are starting recommendations, not guaranteed file size or visual quality. Use lossless for flat diagrams/text. Use the same framing for poster and loop.

background_video.recommendedMaster: Keep the original best-quality video or lossless frame sequence outside the lightweight package.
background_video.sizeFormula: approx MB = bitrate_Mbps * seconds / 8, plus container overhead
background_video.loopPolicy: Cyclic animation with F(N)=F(0); stored frames 0..N-1. Do not normally store duplicate frame N. Compare seam and motion, not just first/last bytes.

browser.reducedMotion: Use poster instead of autoplay when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce
browser.preload: metadata; actual buffering must be tested
browser.delivery: HTTP(S), correct MIME, byte-range requests; local viewer is only a preview.

dealer_video.note: A 720x1280 generation resized to 1080x1920 is upscaled, NOT native 1080. H.264 changes pixels; keystone equality is checked at the correct comparison level.

alphaAlternatives.requires: Actual decode+alpha tests on target browsers and both GPU/CPU compositor paths

alphaAlternatives.format: ProRes 4444 MOV or RGBA PNG sequence

mask.meaning: Local edit mask: 0 = keep original; 255 = accept edited candidate; intermediate = blend.
mask.openaiMaskConversion: RGBA alpha = 255 - localEditMask; transparent pixels are editable. Same dimensions as FIRST reference image.
mask.hardPreservation: After model output, Image.composite(candidate,locked_original,local_mask). Outside local mask original RGBA is copied exactly.
mask.status: Template masks are DRAFT; inspect before first use for each camera/dealer.

keying.warning: Green clothing, reflections and table rails need visual review; chroma key cannot separate an embedded non-green room.

tableAuthoring.coordinates: canonical, including negative x for side extensions
tableAuthoring.sourceOfShape: New illustrative footprint; NOT recovered from camera calibration
tableAuthoring.anchorPolicy: Card targets are authoritative for this family; table outline may be designed around them but must fit the approved dealer camera.
tableAuthoring.contactAndOcclusion: Hands must rest on the table surface; separate foreground rail if necessary. Keep card targets on visible surface.

keepClearCanonical.meaning: Avoid high-contrast distracting movement behind head/hands; not a mathematical alpha cutout.

backgroundAuthoring.sideContent: A mobile room image has no true side information. Outpaint/render sides while preserving centre; do not stretch mobile to wide.

poseWorkflow.newVila: Identity image plus explicit VILA pose/camera reference. No universal .65 scale. Generate candidate, compare, adjust locally if needed, then lock.
poseWorkflow.newRedo: Locked VILA is first reference; REDO is pose guidance. Approve a local hand/arm edit mask, composite back unchanged pixels outside mask.
poseWorkflow.locking: Store immutable PNG and sha256, contract sha256, input hashes and original transform history. Replacing VILA invalidates REDO and marks dependent jobs stale.
poseWorkflow.speechLipsync: Catalog retained; Light does not implement speech/lipsync.

inputRouting.action: Inspect and choose role. Preserve original. Never infer registered pose from portrait aspect ratio.
Role is still required. For pose require visual approval; for table alpha required; for background mobile-only unless sides supplied.
Uniform scale only; record native size and upscaled flag. No aspect distortion.
BLOCK automatic registered import. Extra 8 columns may be real content. Only trim 4+4 when metadata explicitly proves padding.
BLOCK automatic pose normalization. Legacy restoration requires explicit provenance. Real wide source needs a different registered transform.
Keep wide original; centre crop [1167,0,2247,1920] for mobile.
Role-selected uniform height-fit with tiny symmetric edge padding to 3414x1920, logged as resampled/upscaled where applicable. Never apply this rule to dealer or table.
BLOCK; need planned crop with validated safe content or regenerate correct ratio. Do not squeeze to 1080x1920.
Probe, retain original, reject HDR from this SDR pipeline, require explicit conversion; CFR conversion may duplicate/drop frames, timing must be rechecked.
Keep authoring source. Export registered PNG/video first. Never execute embedded content.

openaiReview.allowedAction: Return advisory structured JSON only; no tools or writes
openaiReview.cacheKey: image SHA256 + role + contract SHA256 + model + prompt version

openaiPose.note: All pose references are resampled uniformly. Mask guidance is not hard preservation. Unexpected output size blocks automatic normalization.

runwayPreview.role: two-anchor candidate, not guaranteed exact endpoints

gen4_turbo.note: Deliberately excluded from two-anchor submitter. No silent replacement of end-constrained model.

providerProfiles.billing: Always explicit confirmation per generation. Price shown as unknown rather than an invented number. API billing is separate from ChatGPT subscriptions/MCP workspace plans.
providerProfiles.timeoutState: UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION; keep local attempt, request ID/task ID, do not resubmit automatically.

pixelPerfectClaims.wideCentreCopy: May be verified byte-for-byte decoded RGBA for PNG centre region
pixelPerfectClaims.maskedRedoOutsideRegion: May be verified byte-for-byte decoded RGBA after local composite
pixelPerfectClaims.resampledImage: Not byte-identical to source; verify transformed geometry
pixelPerfectClaims.h264VsPng: Not byte-identical; report decoded error and visual seam separately

qa.silhouetteComparison: Coarse QA, not anatomical landmarks. Arms differ between poses; bbox alone never approves a pose.
qa.motionQa: No automatic approval from equal first/last frames; velocity and acceleration across the seam also matter.
qa.loopRetiming: No automatic ping-pong for dealing. It makes cards reverse physically. No speed-up to reference frame count by default.

neverLog: private original paths unless user puts them into free text
logging.aiLearnedPatterns: Local observation summaries/cached reviews only. No fine-tuning and no self-changing rules.
logging.sourceRetention: Original files are not overwritten; work copies and immutable result revisions remain local.
